findings.title: _block_lines writes an empty depends_on or systems list as a bare header line, which YAML reads as null, so the governance check rolls back the whole write.
findings.evidence: src/governance/mapping.py:37-39. apply_phase_locks with {"phase-irs-08": {"depends_on": [], "systems": ["sys-realization"]}} returned 1: 'backlog:items.285.depends_on: None is not of type array' then 'backlog.yaml rolled back'. 122 of 357 phases carry depends_on: [].
findings.consequence: Any plan whose locks include a root phase cannot be written; the mainstream case of the phase's scope fails. test/test_mapping.py has no empty-list case, so the suite passes.

findings.title: $defs.ordering.items.properties.phase in schemas/gate-decision.schema.json has no phase-id pattern.
findings.evidence: type string, minLength 1; backlog.schema.json uses ^phase-[a-z]+-[0-9]{2}$ for phase ids.
findings.consequence: A mistyped phase id in a proposed ordering validates; the owner ratifying at Gate 3 is the only check.
